ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% coverage of high-intensity (white/light grey) punctate spots and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense clusters of high-intensity pixels localized at the distal tips; sparse, non-uniform distribution of white punctate spots across both the left and right medial lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees at the point of water intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth, creating a jagged silhouette against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex trajectory originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast clusters of circular/ovoid pixel groups concentrated at the distal extremities of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the dark ventral surface, including two distinct parallel rake marks on the left lobe and a prominent diagonal scratch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral scarring and barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes; several visible rake marks across the mid-region of the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated high-saturation orange-hued pixel cluster located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
